creator_brief.ask: Wear it in real life and share an on-hand photo in daylight. Keep it calm and true.
creator_brief.dm: Hi, we love your calm everyday style. We would love to send you our delicate gold ring to wear in your own way. If you like it, please share a real wearing photo and tag us. Thank you so much.
creator_brief.send: Your signature delicate gold ring and a simple gold necklace for layering.
creator_brief.who: Small creators young women trust. Calm soft everyday look. They post morning coffee, simple outfits, and hands showing rings.
